decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9713. Series context: trend strength 0.9824 and seasonal strength 0.3964; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.068); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.153.
